text: the secretary next to it says 225 untagged and then running it says 10/12
resolution: Fixed the secretary stopping after one batch (the '225 untagged, 10/12' finding): SecretaryBar now loops bounded SECRETARY_BATCH turns until nextBatch() drains, with a live tally and unsure entries marked attempted so they never re-queue within a run (a fresh run may retry them). Then killed the infinite capture loop the user screenshotted (req_0235): the repo UserPromptSubmit hook fires on the app's own claude_code workers, so the secretary's prompt was being ledgered and fed back into its next batch — added machinePrefixes to LedgerConfig (secretary preamble, handoff briefs, assist3d viewer preamble; tunable in _config.json), gated FIRST in hookCapturePrompt, made the prompt's first line the shared SECRETARY_PROMPT_PREFIX sentinel, and excluded machine echoes from batching as defense in depth. Also added the user's comment box: noteByUser on the store → the same noteRequest door (actor 'user', any state, even done), input in the wide detail, history shows it. Suites: ledger 26/26, workbench 16/16; commit pending supervisor's word.
